summary.en: Israeli drones struck a Syrian operative planning attacks for Iran near the Lebanon border, while Houthi forces attacked Riyadh's King Khalid Airport, killing 12 and injuring 309. Syrian security forces intensified anti-ISIS operations, pursued former regime loyalists, and engaged private security firms linked to a new Syrian security mogul, while also foiling drug-smuggling attempts on the Iraq and Jordan borders. The UN Security Council discussed the situation, urging Israel to respect the 1974 Disengagement Agreement and calling for an end to Israeli incursions into southern Syria. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels droner slo mot en syrisk operativ som planla angrep for Iran nær Libanons grense, mens houthiene angrep Riyadhs King Khalid flyplass, og drepte 12 og såret 309. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker intensiverte anti-IS-operasjoner, forfulgte tidligere regjeringslojalister og samarbeidet med private sikkerhetsfirmaer knyttet til en ny syrisk sikkerhetsmogul, samtidig som de avverget narkotikasmuglingsforsøk på grensen mot Irak og Jordan. FN-sikkerhetsrådet diskuterte situasjonen, oppfordret Israel til å respektere avtalen fra 1974 om tilbaketrekning og ba om en slutt på israelske inntrengninger i sørlige Syria. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
